exceptions.reason: Fixed Hadoop 2.7.7 provided ABI for the oldest supported NameNode. No Hadoop classes are included in published agent jars or the server runtime. FileUtil.unTar shell filename injection. The adapter and trusted permission fixtures do not execute FileUtil.unTar or YARN localization. This exception does not cover an operator's external legacy Hadoop installation. Review before 2026-12-07; remove when this legacy ABI baseline is retired or a compatible replacement becomes available.

This exception does not cover an operator's external legacy Hadoop installation. Review before 2026-12-07; remove when this legacy ABI baseline is retired or a compatible replacement becomes available.
